adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `parseRefreshTokenResponse` which, when the parsed data lacks `refresh_token`, forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts). In Office365’s refresh path, the code now does `const tokenResponse = parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema);` and then spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). Under the sharing-enabled path, the minimum schema does not require/expect `refresh_token`, so responses that omit `refresh_token` will get the sentinel value inserted and then overwrite the previously stored real refresh token during the spread, causing credential corruption/data loss. The finding’s test-fixture ambiguity point is secondary, but the overwrite behavior is directly implied by the diff.
